title: Salience Effect
coreMove: Name the salience effect in the room, then redesign the next choice so it cannot choose for you.
sourcePressure: The frozen TOC and official source notes frame Salience Effect as a specific decision error around salience, vivid detail, base importance. Traceable support includes Do Analysts Overreact?.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating Salience Effect as generic advice to be smarter, instead of forcing this exact move: name the salience effect in the room, then redesign the next choice so it cannot choose for you.
